name: Chainwrought Gaol-Queen

Traits.name: One Sentence, Spoken Through Every Link
Traits.text: While a creature is bound by the gaol-queen's chains, The gaol-queen perceives everything the bound creature perceives and can whisper into the minds of any creatures within 5 feet of it, regardless of language or distance.
Traits.clause: While a creature is bound by the gaol-queen's chains, she senses what it senses and speaks in the heads of those beside

Traits.name: Aura of Authority
Traits.text: While in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the gaol-queen, the gaol-queen and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the gaol-queen doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The gaol-queen makes three attacks, using Chain Whip or Hurled Prisoner in any combination.

Actions.name: Chain Whip
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 10 ft. 33 (11d4 + 6) Slashing damage.

Actions.name: Hurled Prisoner
Actions.text: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +11, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. 33 (6d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Restrained condition until the end of the gaol-queen's next turn. This effect can be applied only once per turn.
weldedRiders: If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Restrained condition until the end of the gaol-queen's next turn. This effect can be applied only once per turn.

lore: A jailer who fed her own name to the iron cuffs she wore, she now keeps a cell wherever she stands and fills it with anyone within reach, watching from behind a living wall of those she claims.

generation.userConcept: a gaol-queen whose prisoners fight for her while she watches from behind them

clauses.text: a gaol-queen whose prisoners fight for her while she watches from behind them
